# What editors put on the clipboard, written by hand in the shape they have: Google Docs, Microsoft
# Word, a web page copied from a browser, a spreadsheet, a rich text editor's value, plain text, a
# rendered markdown page, a code editor. Clean reads tags and a block's alignment only: the underline,
# strikethrough and code font Google Docs and code editors write in a span's style are the editor's to
# map when it pastes (the browser side), not Clean's. Same format as xss.txt.

== a web page copied from a browser
<meta charset='utf-8'><h1 class="title" style="font-size: 2em; color: rgb(17, 17, 17);">Kitwork engine</h1><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">A <code style="background: rgb(240, 240, 240);">.ui</code> page is a file. See the <a href="https://kitwork.io/docs/ui" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: rgb(0, 102, 204);">guide</a> <img src="https://kitwork.io/arrow.svg" alt="" width="12"> or the <a href="/roadmap">roadmap</a>.</p><figure><img src="shot.png" alt="Screenshot"><figcaption>A page in the browser</figcaption></figure><pre style="background: rgb(246, 248, 250);"><code>import { db } from "./database.work"
const get = () =&gt; db.users.all()</code></pre><blockquote><p>Dễ như JS, chặt như TS.</p></blockquote><ol><li>Install</li><li>Write a page</li></ol>
-- want
<h2>Kitwork engine</h2>
<p>A <code>.ui</code> page is a file. See the <a href="https://kitwork.io/docs/ui">guide</a> or the <a href="/roadmap">roadmap</a>.</p>
<p>A page in the browser</p>
<pre><code>import { db } from "./database.work"
const get = () =&gt; db.users.all()</code></pre>

<p>Dễ như JS, chặt như TS.</p>
</blockquote>

<li>Write a page</li>
</ol>

== plain text from a form
Chào anh,{LF}{LF}Đơn hàng #1024 đã giao.{LF}Cảm ơn anh!{LF}{LF}{LF}  -- Quán cà phê
-- want
<p>Chào anh,</p>
<p>Đơn hàng #1024 đã giao.<br>Cảm ơn anh!</p>
<p>-- Quán cà phê</p>

== plain text with Windows line breaks and markup-like characters
1 < 2 && 3 > 2{CR}{LF}a <3 b, "quoted" & 'single'{CR}{LF}{CR}{LF}&amp; stays as written
-- want
<p>1 &lt; 2 &amp;&amp; 3 &gt; 2<br>a &lt;3 b, "quoted" &amp; 'single'</p>
<p>&amp;amp; stays as written</p>

== Microsoft Word: centred and right-aligned paragraphs, a small heading, insertions and deletions
<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><b><span lang=VI>Hợp đồng</span></b></p>
<p class=MsoNormal align=right style='text-align:right'><span lang=VI>Số 12/2026</span></p>
<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span lang=VI>Điều 1. Hai bên thoả thuận.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
<h4><span lang=VI>Điều khoản nhỏ<o:p></o:p></span></h4>
<p class=MsoNormal align=center><ins cite="mailto:quoc@kitwork.io" datetime="2026-10-20T09:00">thêm</ins> <del cite="mailto:quoc@kitwork.io">bỏ</del></p>
-- want
<p class="align-center"><strong>Hợp đồng</strong></p>
<p class="align-right">Số 12/2026</p>
<p>Điều 1. Hai bên thoả thuận.</p>
<h4>Điều khoản nhỏ</h4>
<p class="align-center"><u>thêm</u> <s>bỏ</s></p>

== a rendered markdown page: small headings, inline code, keys, a highlighted code block, a rule
<h4 dir="auto">Cài đặt</h4><p dir="auto">Chạy <code class="notranslate">go test ./...</code> rồi <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>.</p><div class="highlight highlight-source-go notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">func</span> <span class="pl-en">main</span>() {
{TAB}<span class="pl-s1">fmt</span>.<span class="pl-en">Println</span>(<span class="pl-s">"xin chào"</span>)
}</pre></div><hr><h5 dir="auto">Ghi chú</h5><h6 dir="auto">Nhỏ nhất</h6><p dir="auto"><del>cũ</del> <ins>mới</ins> <samp>out</samp> <tt>tt</tt></p>
-- want
<h4>Cài đặt</h4>
<p>Chạy <code>go test ./...</code> rồi <code>Ctrl</code>+<code>C</code>.</p>
<pre><code>func main() {
{TAB}fmt.Println("xin chào")
}</code></pre>
<hr>
<h5>Ghi chú</h5>
<h6>Nhỏ nhất</h6>
<p><s>cũ</s> <u>mới</u> <code>out</code> <code>tt</code></p>

== a code editor's copy: a div a line, white space and a code font in style
<meta charset='utf-8'><div style="color: #cccccc;background-color: #1f1f1f;font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;font-weight: normal;font-size: 14px;line-height: 19px;white-space: pre;"><div><span style="color: #569cd6;">const</span><span style="color: #cccccc;"> </span><span style="color: #4fc1ff;">x</span><span style="color: #cccccc;"> = </span><span style="color: #b5cea8;">1</span><span style="color: #cccccc;">;</span></div><div><span style="color: #cccccc;">    </span><span style="color: #dcdcaa;">log</span><span style="color: #cccccc;">(</span><span style="color: #4fc1ff;">x</span><span style="color: #cccccc;">);</span></div></div>
-- want
<p>const x = 1;</p>
<p>log(x);</p>
